atomic_z_baseline.audit_type: public repository metadata, README/license/docs, tree inventory and targeted source inspection
not_performed: full line-by-line inspection of every file in the 1.19 GB DankNooner repository
runtime execution of external games or binaries
dynamic tracing of proprietary game executables
third-party source or asset import into Atomic-Z

policy.default: study-only until exact licence scope, provenance, compatibility and project approval are established
policy.no_game_assets: Do not commit EA/Activision game assets, retail executables, game data tables, proprietary audio, textures, fonts or decompilation dumps.
policy.no_second_runtime: External engines/runtimes are reference material only; Godot remains Atomic-Z's sole product runtime.
policy.pinning: Use immutable commit IDs. Mutable branch links are not considered reproducible evidence.
policy.asset_provenance: Record source page, per-asset licence, acquisition date, file hash, dimensions, scale, coordinate convention and validation result.

sources.name: DankNooner

licence.scope: repository licence; bundled assets/dependencies may have independent terms

sources.atomic_z_decision: Architecture and behaviour reference only. Do not copy AGPL code or bundled game assets; engine and renderer targets do not match Atomic-Z.

sources.name: moto-player-controller-godot

licence.scope: repository licence; assets and add-ons require separate notices

sources.atomic_z_decision: Predecessor reference; not an approved plug-in. AGPL and Godot version/renderer mismatch. Movement model is arcade-oriented, not a validated two-wheel rigid-body solver.

sources.name: OpenNFS

licence.scope: original repository code only; bundled dependencies and EA game assets/data remain under separate rights

sources.atomic_z_decision: Study and selectively reimplement concepts in Godot. No C++ engine import; four-wheel car physics is not a motorcycle model. Never import EA assets/data.

sources.name: SPEED RE — NFS Underground 2 source reconstruction

revision.note: Repository is visible on GitHub but an immutable commit could not be retrieved through the connected GitHub API during this audit.

relevance: byte matching vs bounded behavioural comparisons
sources.atomic_z_decision: Study README/methodology only. No source import, no automated fetch and no original game binaries/assets/disassembly.
